metadata.title: Estimates for Ratios of Low-Order Eigenvalues of the Laplacian with Muckenhoupt Weights on Euclidean Domains
metadata.abstract: We study low-order eigenvalue ratio estimates for the Laplacian with Muckenhoupt $A_2$ weights. For weights bounded above and below, we prove a universal upper bound for $\lambda_2/\lambda_1$ with constant $1 + \frac{4}{n}\,\frac{C}{c}$, linear in the ratio of the weight bounds, and recover the classical Payne-Pólya-Weinberger bound as a special case. For radial decreasing weights, we prove that the ball maximizes $\lambda_2/\lambda_1$ among domains of equal volume, assuming that an admissible radial test function exists (Definition 5.8) and that on the ball the second eigenvalue is attained by the $l=1$ mode. The argument adapts the method of Ashbaugh--Benguria to the weighted setting via a weighted Chiti comparison theorem and a monotonicity property of the admissible radial test function (Definition 5.8). Higher-order eigenvalue ratios are estimated in terms of the $(n-1)$-Hausdorff measure of the boundary, under an explicit balance condition on the weight at the covering scale. The generalized Payne-Pólya-Weinberger conjecture for eigenvalue sums remains open in general; conditional results are presented for restricted families of domains.

analysis.workSummary: 对上下界为c、C的Muckenhoupt A2权，得λ2/λ1≤1+(4/n)(C/c)。径向递减权下，同体积球的谱比最大性还要求存在Definition5.8的容许径向测试函数，且球上第二特征值由l=1模态取得；高阶谱比在覆盖尺度权平衡条件下由边界Hausdorff测度控制。
analysis.breakthrough: 将经典谱比技术推广到加权情形并分清哪些球极值结论需额外结构。
analysis.limitations: 球最大性是有条件定理，不是全部A2或径向权的普遍PPW定理；特征值和的广义PPW猜想摘要明确仍开放。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
